lines.zh: 我横着爬过河底的卵石。
lines.en: I scuttle sideways over river pebbles.
My claws stay raised, ready to pinch.

lines.zh: 冷水河底滑，我走得小心。
lines.en: The cold riverbed is slick; I step carefully.
I back into a gap between stones.

lines.zh: 尾巴一弹，我倒着窜出去。
lines.en: One flick of my tail shoots me backward.

lines.zh: 河水推我，我偏要顶着走。
lines.en: The river pushes; I push back.
Stones in the tropical river feel warm.
I work along the riverbank hunting food.
My eight legs rustle over the sand.
I stop and raise both claws.
Mud slides off my shell.

lines.zh: 烂木头的味道引我过去。
lines.en: The smell of rotten wood pulls me over.
The river is shallow, easier to walk.
Do not step here; this path is mine.
I sprawl my legs over a warm stone.
I groom my antennae with a claw.

lines.zh: 太阳照得河面发白，我眯眼。
lines.en: Sun bleaches the river surface; I squint.

lines.zh: 岸边的碎石被人踩响了。
lines.en: Someone is crunching gravel on the bank.
My shell is straining; time to shed it.

lines.zh: 我吐个气泡，看它漂上水面。
lines.en: I blow a bubble and watch it surface.
The river sand is cool against me.
I raise my eye stalks and look around.
Who turned this stone over?
I tap my shell; it rings sharp.

lines.zh: 一只小鱼从我面前溜了。
lines.en: A small fish slipped past my face.
I grind my claws and wait for dark.
I know this stretch of river well.
It is so quiet only water speaks.

lines.zh: 你在岸上蹲下，影子进水了。
lines.en: You crouch on the bank; your shadow enters the water.
Is that a net in your hand?
I raise a claw; you raise a hand.
You crouch; I back away.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩塌了我的洞。
lines.en: Your boot caved in my burrow.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，眼睛在杆上转。
lines.en: I stare, eyes turning on their stalks.
Do not reach in; I will pinch.
Looking for a crawfish? That is me.
Your reflection looks more nervous than me.
I circle halfway around your feet.
Your hands smell of river fish blood.
What are you looking at? Walk on.
My shell has been cracked.
Blood seeps out through the seam.
I am on my back, legs kicking.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打得眼前发黑。
lines.en: That hit left my eyes swimming.
I have one point left; no more.
This claw of mine has gone stiff.
It hurts; I squeeze into a gap.
Who stepped on me? I remember.
Half my antenna is gone.
The river makes the wound cold.

lines.zh: 那块腐肉的味道飘过来了。
lines.en: The smell of that carrion drifts over.
Something sank to the riverbed.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼肠子给我吗？
lines.en: Are those fish guts for me?
I crawl toward that trace of blood.
The smell under this stone is the best.
I smell a dead fish in the water.

lines.zh: 那团东西在动，我要看看。
lines.en: That lump is moving; I must look.

lines.zh: 别抖那东西，我眼睛跟不上。
lines.en: Stop jiggling it; my eyes cannot follow.
I am hungry; my claws are open.
Lower the bait a little.

lines.zh: 你踢翻了我，我翻了个身。
lines.en: You kicked me over; I flipped.

lines.zh: 壳撞在石头上，响了一声。
lines.en: My shell cracked against a stone.
Stop shoving; this gap is mine.
Your push slid me sideways.
I have pinched your boot tip.
Let me by; do not block this path.
You stepped on one of my claws.
The water is all mud now.
I right myself and come at you again.
One bump and I remember forever.
I tap my shell to call another.
Its claws are a size smaller than mine.
We lie side by side under a stone.
I touch it with my antennae.
This river can raise a brood.
It backs off; I follow anyway.
Do not watch; this is private.

lines.zh: 我们各自守着一块石头。
lines.en: We each guard a stone.
It pinched me, not hard.
When it is done I return to my burrow.
I pick up a pebble with my claw.

lines.zh: 这分量压得我抬不起螯。
lines.en: This weight pins my claws to the ground.
This fish bone is mine now.
I hide it in a gap and cover it with mud.
It dropped; I pick it up again.
I carry a shell two steps.
This snail shell fits me well.
I will take that scrap you dropped.
Both my claws are full.
Who stole my stash?
Something is moving in the gap.

lines.zh: 我看见一条尾巴闪过去。
lines.en: I saw a tail flick past.
There is blood in the water, close.
That little fish swims too slowly.
I raise my claws and mark it.
A bug fell into the river.
It is turning stones, hunting.
This riverbed answers to me.
The noise is right at my left.
Who is lurking at my burrow mouth?
I smell a soft-shelled thing.
That shadow flinched at me.
I move first; it is already too slow.
Got you; do not think of running.

lines.zh: 我把壳压低，一点点挪近。
lines.en: I flatten my shell and inch closer.
My claws open wide, waiting.
It pulls back; I push forward.

lines.zh: 河水把我的味道盖住了。
lines.en: The river hides my scent.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底绕到它后头。
lines.en: I hug the riverbed and slip behind it.
It has not noticed the stone moving.
I track every little shift it makes.
Almost; half a block closer.
It hides deeper; I follow.
My claw is already lined up.
Its breathing is louder than the river.

lines.zh: 我等它把壳张开一道缝。
lines.en: I wait for it to open a shell seam.
This pinch will not miss.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛转到另一边了。
lines.en: Its eyes have turned the other way.

lines.zh: 我举起螯，等它游进石缝。
lines.en: I raise my claws and wait for it to enter the crack.
I clamp down on its leg.
The claw closes with a click.
It squealed and tore loose.
I strike again to be sure.
The soft parts pinch best.
Its blood mixes into the river.
I pin it against a stone.
Once I pinch, I do not let go.

lines.zh: 个子比我大，我也照样夹。
lines.en: Bigger than me, and I still pinch.
I tear off a small piece.
That one it will remember.
My claws ache from pinching.
It ran; I chase two steps.
The riverbed goes quiet again.
I crawl out from under the pebbles.
My shell is still soft; I hide.
This cold river makes me pull in.
I hatched alongside another.

lines.zh: 热带河的泥沙暖烘烘的。
lines.en: The tropical mud is warm.
Lifting my claws the first time is heavy.
River water runs over my shell.
I claim a stone for my burrow.
Footsteps above; stay still.
I am small; my pinch hurts no one.
Cold river, warm river, I know both.
The stones below are rough on me.
I crawl a few steps deeper.
A crawfish, counting from today.

lines.zh: 水草底下还有几个卵壳。
lines.en: A few egg shells are left under the weed.
I crawl out of the crack and start sideways.
The water boils; my shell turns red.
I fell from the bank back into the river.

lines.zh: 我被冲得太深，喘不上气。
lines.en: I was swept too deep to breathe.
The blast tumbled me shell over shell.
An arrow stuck in my shell.
Strange power runs through my shell.

lines.zh: 河底空了，我找不到吃的。
lines.en: The riverbed is empty; no food.

lines.zh: 雷落进河里，我全身一抽。
lines.en: Lightning hit the river and I convulsed.
The water ended; I fell into nothing.
